riddle: Iei kaei kaba ïaid khlem kjat, kaba phet khlem thait?
solution: Ka Wah (The River / नदी)
english_hint: Flows forever through Khasi valleys without feet or tiredness.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba don shispah ki khmat hynrei kam ïohi?
solution: U Sohtrun (Pineapple / अनानास)
english_hint: Crown of leaves and a hundred golden eyes that cannot see.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba saw haba ka dangrit, ba ïong haba ka heh?
solution: U Mawïong (Coal / कोयला)
english_hint: The dark stone extracted from the ridges of Meghalaya.

riddle: Haba phi pyndonkam phi bret, haba phi dep phi shim biang?
solution: Ka Jar tong dohkha (Fishing net / मछली का जाल)
english_hint: Cast into stream and pulled back with catch.

riddle: Iei kaei ba heh ka pla hynrei ym don pisa?
solution: Ka Shang ne Ka Khoh (Woven bamboo storage basket / बाँस की टोकरी)
english_hint: A woven Khasi mountain backpack basket carried on the back by forehead strap.

riddle: Haba wan ka buh, haba leit ka shim?
solution: Ka Um ne Ka Wah (The river or water wave / नदी की लहर)
english_hint: Brings pebbles and sand on coming, carries them away on receding.

riddle: Shisien shong, shisien ïeng, um pat shong shuh haduh ba ïap?
solution: U Dieng (A Tree / वृक्ष)
english_hint: Sprouts once from the earth, stands tall all its life, never sits until it falls dead.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba don ki shkor hynrei kam ïohsngew?
solution: Ka Khiewja (The cooking pot handles / हांडी के कान)
english_hint: Has two handles on either side like ears, but cannot hear anything.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba im ha ka ding, ba ïap ha ka um?
solution: Ka Ding ne U Rnga (Fire or Charcoal / आग अथवा अंगारा)
english_hint: Thrives on fuel and heat, instantly dies when doused with water.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba don khlieh khlem shñiuh, bad don kjat khlem juti?
solution: U Tit (Mushroom / खुंभी / मशरूम)
english_hint: Grows in forest moss with a rounded cap and single stem.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba pynshad ïa u khla haba ym don bom?
solution: U Khnai (The mouse / चूहा)
english_hint: Makes the feline leap and dash through the underbrush.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba rit eh hynrei ka lah ban pyndap ïa ka kamra baroh?
solution: Ka Sharak ne Ka Jingshai (A lamp flame / दीपक की लौ)
english_hint: Tiny flame that fills an entire dark room with golden light.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba phong jaiñ saw haba dangrit, ba phong jaiñ jyrngam haba la heh?
solution: U Sohmynken (Chili pepper / मिर्च)
english_hint: Changes color from green to fiery red on ripening.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba bam ïa ka met jong ka hi haduh ban da kut?
solution: Ka Momkhati (Candle / मोमबत्ती)
english_hint: Consumes its own wax body while giving light until extinguished.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba don shyntur hynrei kam kren?
solution: Ka Wah ne Ka Krem (River mouth or cave portal / गुफा का द्वार या नदी का मुहाना)
english_hint: Has an opening or mouth that never utters a single spoken word.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba saw dong hynrei kam don kdong?
solution: Ka Miet (Night / रात)
english_hint: Envelops the earth in four cardinal directions simultaneously.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba bsa ïa u briew hynrei um ju shimti?
solution: Ka Meiramew (Mother Earth / धरती माता)
english_hint: Nourishes all living humanity perpetually without ever asking repayment.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba phong pansngiat ksiar hynrei kam dei ka syiem?
solution: Ka Sngi (The Sun / सूर्य)
english_hint: Wears a golden diadem of blazing rays across the mountain horizon.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba ryngkang ïa ka lum khlem pait ka kjat?
solution: Ka Lyer (The mountain wind / पवन / हवा)
english_hint: Leaps effortlessly over the highest ridges without limbs or shoes.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba sum baroh shisngi hynrei kam jhieh?
solution: Ka Syngkai ne Ka Dur (The shadow / परछाई)
english_hint: Bathes in waterfalls and streams all day without ever becoming wet.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba ïam haba ka leit, ba kmen haba ka wan?
solution: Ka Lyoh Slap (The rain cloud / मेघ / बारिश का बादल)
english_hint: Weeps pouring raindrops on the valleys, rejoiced by farmers on arrival.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba don shispah ki tyrsim hynrei kam thaba?
solution: U Shken ne U Siej (A bamboo clump / बाँस की झाड़ी)
english_hint: Clusters of a hundred spiked shoots that never strike.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba lah ban pait haba phi tang shu kren ïa ka kyrteng jong ka?
solution: Ka Jingjar-jar (Silence / खामोशी / मौन)
english_hint: Shattered the moment you utter its name.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba kiew hynrei kam ju hiar?
solution: Ka Rta jong u briew (Human age / मनुष्य की आयु)
english_hint: Increases continuously year after year and never decreases.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba nang khraw katba phi nang shim noh na ka?
solution: Ka Thliew (A hole in the ground / गड्ढा)
english_hint: The more earth you remove from it, the bigger it becomes.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba don snieh hynrei kam don doh, don sla hynrei kam don thied?
solution: Ka Kot (A book / पुस्तक)
english_hint: Has a binding cover and leaves/pages, full of knowledge.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba rung ha ka ïing khlem plie jingkhang?
solution: Ka Jingshai sngi (Sunlight / सूर्य का प्रकाश)
english_hint: Enters through crevices without opening any wooden doors.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba her khlem thapniang, ba ïam khlem khmat?
solution: Ka Lyoh (A cloud / बादल)
english_hint: Drifts across blue skies without wings and sheds tears without eyes.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba teh ïa ar ngut hynrei tang iwei i ba bat?
solution: Ka Sati shongkurim (A wedding ring / विवाह की अंगूठी)
english_hint: Binds two souls in matrimony while encircling a single finger.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba phet kloi ban ïa ka kjat, ba jngai ban ïa ka sngi?
solution: Ka Jingmut ne Ka Jingpyrkhat (The human thought or mind / मानव विचार)
english_hint: Travels faster than light to the ends of the universe in a fraction of a second.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba shong halor u dieng ba phai khmat sha khyndew?
solution: U Sohpyrshit ne U Sohtrun (Hanging wild fruit / फल)
english_hint: Suspended from branches, gazing down at Mother Earth until ripe.

riddle: Iei kaei kaba ngi donkam ban thied ban pynjot?
solution: U Phuljhari ne Ka Bom phliah (Fireworks / आतिशबाजी)
english_hint: Purchased specifically to ignite and burn into sparks.
